reasoning: On the season so far the 76ers are the stronger team; with home court the Pacers start about 1 points better, in a game of about 232 points.
Rest, travel and who is missing tilt it about 1 point towards the Pacers.
There are psychological storylines, but history says they are worth little here.
Bottom line: the Pacers win 57 times in 100, by about 3; most games like this end between 205 and 253 total points.
